text:
maya: Quick heads-up — scheduling a release into the 02:00 UTC change window. Target set: api v3.2.4, runtime v1.18, router v0.9.3. Console needs schema migration step before router flip.
liam: Are we going to pin the router variant or rely on compatibility routing? If not pinned, we risk console/ui mismatches during rollout.
maya: Plan is to pin router and runtime for the first wave. API will be allowed to float to latest minor. Deploybot will apply pinned variants.
jen: Rollback criteria we agreed on: 
- >5% overall error rate vs baseline sustained for 5m OR
- p95 latency increase >50% sustained for 3m OR
- any trace-level header mismatch errors reported by router->api.
If any trigger fires, immediate rollback to previous pinned runtime+router.
deploybot: scheduled deploy by @maya in 2 hours. Canary config: 10% traffic for 15m, healthchecks every 30s. Command preview: 
```
/deploy api=v3.2.4 runtime=v1.18 router=v0.9.3 pin=true canary=10m:15%
```
liam: Also need console flag enabled: `console.split_kv=true` before the router switch. Otherwise KV header split causes 400s.
maya: Adding release notes here: https://go.redwood/release/2026-03-21 — includes console migration steps and the short rollback playbook.
jen: Canary ramp plan: 10% for 15m, check for increased 5xxs, traces, and key customer routes. If good, 50% for 10m, then 100% with staggered zone rollouts.
liam: If canary fails, fallback plan: set runtime back to v1.17 immediately, pin router to fallback pool and roll traffic to fallback pool in the router. I can run the traffic-steer script: `ops/steer --pool=fallback --reason=canary-fail`.
maya: I'll push the console migration doc and pin the router variant. Tagging @oncall for monitoring handoff.
ops-bot: @oncall alerted. Dashboards to watch: infra/api-5xx, runtime-kv-errors, router-p95, console-migration-errors. Alerts configured. :eyes:
oncall: ACK. I'll watch dashboards and be ready to run rollback steps.
jen: One more note — update the changelog entry with schema version and the migration window. If DB migration is needed, block routing switch until it's confirmed.
maya: Copy. I'll update deploy checklist and add a short CLI to unpin in case we need emergency immediate rollback: `deploybot unpin router v0.9.3` — but we'll prefer controlled rollback first.
liam: LGTM. Will standby for canary metrics and ready to execute `ops/steer` if needed.
maya: Thanks team. I'll start the preflight 30m before window and post a final go/no-go in this thread. :timer_clock:
